key.name: opacity
key.description: Opacity of the matched panel background color, in percent.

key.name: maximized-opacity
key.summary: Panel background opacity with maximized windows
key.description: Opacity of the panel background, in percent, while a maximized or fullscreen window is on the primary monitor.

key.name: gradient
key.description: Fade the panel background vertically from the opacity at the top edge to the gradient bottom opacity at the bottom edge, letting a blur behind the panel show through. A maximized or fullscreen window on the primary monitor turns it off.

key.name: gradient-opacity
key.description: Opacity of the panel background at its bottom edge, in percent, while the gradient is on.

key.name: brightness-compensation
key.description: How strongly the panel color is darkened, bright colors more and dark ones barely, so the white text stands out over a backdrop close to its brightness, with its saturation boosted slightly to keep it vivid, in percent. A translucent panel darkens its color further for the same effect. 0 disables it.

key.name: text-contrast
key.description: How strongly bright colors are darkened to keep the white panel text readable, in percent. 0 disables it; 100 enforces 4.5:1 contrast.

key.name: invert-text
key.description: Instead of darkening a color too bright for the white panel text, keep it and turn the text and symbolic icons black whenever black reads better. The text contrast strength sets how much white is preferred: at 100 the color with more contrast wins, at 50 black needs twice the contrast of white, and at 0 the text never turns dark.

key.name: text-shadow
key.description: Outline the panel text and symbolic icons with a soft shadow in the opposite color, black behind white text and white behind dark text, for sharper contrast.

key.name: wallpaper-accent
key.description: Set the system accent color to the one closest to the wallpaper's most prominent hue.

key.name: saved-accent
key.description: The user's own accent color, restored when the wallpaper accent is turned off. Empty when nothing is saved.

key.name: debug
key.description: Log sampled colors and overview events to the journal.
